# M9 hardening fixture

`rgb8-jxlc.jxl` is the unchanged CC0 `rgb8-jxlc` case generated by
`benchmark/jpegxl/generate-lossless-corpus.ts` with pinned libjxl 0.12.0. It
contains a 43 by 35 lossless RGB8 codestream in a `jxlc` container. The M9
resource gate splits that container into `jxlp` sections to exercise the
section-count limit without depending on generated, ignored corpus files.
